title: Living Stone
speaker: Pastor Erica Roth
description: Being a living stone means embodying both strength and adaptability in faith. Unlike static stones, living stones are dynamic and responsive while maintaining foundational strength. This requires daily spiritual preparation by clearing away malice, pretense, and envy while drinking deeply of God's kindness. As living stones, we work together to build a sanctuary vibrant with life - not just a physical building, but the sacred space we create through relationships and community. Some people stumble over Christ as the cornerstone because they encounter Him but fail to be changed by the experience. Building with living stones takes time and requires finding the right combination where each person fits, sometimes requiring shifts in position to better support the overall structure.
